To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(1) MP2 and DFT methods provide very similar values of the first hyperpolarzability beta for D/A substituted pi conjugated systems; (2) The best DFT functional to calculate beta is M05 2x; (3) DFT calculations are much cheaper than MP2 ones, therefore, M05 02X can be used for systematic predictions of molecular hyperpolaizabilities; (4) Experimental beta values for D/A substituted molecules are inconsistent, and
the M05 02X functional provides an accurate description of the molecular first hyper-polarizability for D/A substituted pi conjugated molecules with long conjugation bridges.
